name: a2uicatalog-docs
description: A genuinely separate MCP server from a2uicatalog (https://a2uicatalog.ai/mcp): this one answers questions FROM this product's own documentation (auth, versioning, pricing, API surface, runbook catalog) rather than taking product actions. search_docs(query) returns ranked, real (never fabricated) sections with the source URL.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Use this to answer a question about the product (auth, versioning, pricing, API surface, runbook catalog) from its own documentation, given a plain-English query. Returns {results}: ranked sections, each with title, section, a text snippet, a score and the real source URL, never fabricated content; empty if nothing matches.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: Use this to browse everything the documentation index holds when you have no specific query, or to see what topics exist before searching. Returns the indexed sections as entries of title, section and url, up to max_results.
